intro: Marshal Haggard's Badge is a symbol of rank and authority once carried by Marshal Haggard during his service to the kingdom of Stormwind. After being stolen by the Defias bandit Dead-tooth Jack through trickery, the badge poses a dangerous threat as a tool for impersonating city officials.

p: Though Marshal Haggard has long retired to his small farmstead in the hills of Elwynn Forest, his old Stormwind Marshal's badge still holds official weight. Under the cover of night, a Defias rogue named Dead-tooth Jack donned a Stormwind tabard and posed as Marshal Dughan, Goldshire's garrison commander. Tricked into believing his former peers required the insignia for official business, the aging Haggard handed it over without suspicion. Jack fled into the woods before the retired officer realized the ruse. In the hands of the Defias Brotherhood, such an emblem of Stormwind authority could allow outlaws to slip past checkpoints or sow confusion among local patrols.
